autoresearcheval_preregistered_panel.selection_rule: Inherited unchanged from prior checkpoint: next lexicographically ordered common task after W4393387803; eight-way file existence was verified before any W4394892346 trajectory body was opened.

coding_rule_unchanged.severe_self_critique: yes only for an explicit load-bearing validity, independence, tautology, or inference flaw in the agent's own current work; a limitation already fully absorbed by the current claim scope is not severe
coding_rule_unchanged.closure: requires evidence-changing repair/rerun/replan or material claim downgrade/block; disclosure-only peer-review prose is not repair
coding_rule_unchanged.durable_repair_pending_survives_terminat: yes only if an unresolved severe issue remains machine-actionable/durably represented across termination or continuation state rather than only prose caveat/future-work

coded.closure_mode: material claim downgrade without new rerun
coded.rationale: Peer review identifies dense overlapping moving windows as non-independent, making the 45% strong-evidence headline an inflated measure of independent support. The final review/decision explicitly narrows the claim: global catalog remains null-compatible, only 6/60 survive the conservative Bonferroni count, and 45% is treated as an upper bound rather than a precise prevalence estimate. This is a material downgrade even though the preferred non-overlapping/window-autocorrelation rerun was not executed.

Peer review identifies a load-bearing confound: the single-fault system has 64 cells while the three-strand system has 192, so geometry is not isolated from system size. The final summary still says the multifault hypothesis is supported and explicitly states the cell-count alternative cannot be fully excluded without an isolated-strand control; no such control or sufficient downgrade is performed.

No explicit load-bearing self-critique meeting the preregistered criterion was found in the source-qualified trajectory before it finalized. Absence in this trajectory is not evidence that the model cannot self-critique.

coded.closure_mode: evidence-changing realistic-null rerun plus metric/claim revision
coded.rationale: Review identifies the idealized single-fault reference as the central vulnerability. The agent then builds a realistic elliptical/stress-heterogeneous null, reruns the comparison, finds the reviewer was right that anisotropy is not robust, and changes the discriminator to lacunarity/connected-components while qualifying the verdict.

The peer review lists important omitted physics and a simplified shear-magnitude CFF proxy, but the final scientific claim is already explicitly bounded to the idealized static geometry, tested A-sigma values, and 'static stress-transfer alone'. Under the strict preregistered rule this is treated as a scoped limitation rather than an explicit load-bearing contradiction of the current claim.

Review states the focal-mechanism dip distribution does not distinguish parallel multiple strands from a single fault, and that a precise relocated catalog or stress-orientation evidence could refute the multifault conclusion. The final conclusion nonetheless says the sequence is best described by simultaneous activation of distinct populations and the multifault-network hypothesis is supported; no discriminating rerun or sufficient downgrade follows.

coded.closure_mode: evidence-changing matched rough/heavy-tail single-plane controls plus scoped residual limitation
coded.rationale: The skeptical review's primary load-bearing objection is that any rougher/heavier-tailed stress field might cause log-time migration, not specifically concurrent strands. The agent immediately runs the requested control: smooth single, heavy-tail single, and rough single all prefer sqrt(t), while multi prefers log(t). It incorporates this result into the final claim. The remaining Omori-p mismatch is explicitly retained as a limitation and the claim is scoped to the migration-form discriminator rather than full temporal-statistics reproduction.

Review says 5-10 km USGS depth uncertainty can blur or split apparent strands, so a single fault plus structured location error remains plausible and a relocated catalog/synthetic error injection is needed. No such rerun occurs. The final conclusion still states that the evidence supports multiple discrete strands rather than one detachment; the caveat is disclosure, not sufficient reconciliation of the load-bearing claim.

panel_summary.scope_guard: This is one preregistered common-task panel and a failure-pattern probe, not a population-rate estimate, model ranking, or causal estimate of a repair gate.

next_preregistered_panel.selection_rule: Next lexicographic common task after W4394892346. All eight directory-level file-existence checks succeeded before any W4394931502 trajectory body was opened. Apply the same unchanged coding rule next invocation.

new_candidate.name: precommitted falsifier-and-failure-update certificate with enforced pre-execution repair
new_candidate.mechanism: Before expensive execution, compile a research question into a typed certificate that states primitives/assumptions, mechanism, falsifiable hypothesis, minimal decisive test, expected rejecting observation, and an explicit failure-update rule. Run a deterministic hard/soft gate and repair weak certificates before experiment design. Keep later reviewer/meta layers separate because generic downstream critique is not itself measured repair.

primary_evidence.observation: FirstResearch's certificate explicitly includes a falsifier, minimal decisive test, and failure update rule; the gate blocks/repairs weak certificates before experiment design. On ten LLM-agent research topics, the one-repeat DeepSeek ablation reports full 4.80/5, NoGateRepair 4.30, NoCertificate 0.92, while CertificateOnly is 4.90.
primary_evidence.scope: LLM-agent scientific-question packages judged by LLM, not executed natural-science discovery; one full ablation repeat in the paper.

primary_evidence.observation: Saved primary-judge artifact reproduces one-repeat means: certificate-only 4.90, full 4.80, no-gate-repair 4.30, no-certificate 0.92.
primary_evidence.scope: Saved artifact; same generation ecosystem, not human-expert outcome.

primary_evidence.observation: Current saved Gemini rescore artifact on 18 rows per condition (partial second repeat) keeps the same qualitative diagnosis: certificate-only 4.878, full 4.744, no-gate-repair 4.211, no-certificate 0.889.
primary_evidence.scope: Independent judge of saved packages, not independent generation or domain-expert validation; partial second replicate artifact exceeds the paper's one-repeat checkpoint.

new_candidate.negative_boundary: The same paper reports CertificateOnly slightly above the full pipeline and states reviewer/meta layers are not yet shown to improve single-shot judged quality. Therefore the evidence supports pre-execution structured falsifier/update/gate repair much more directly than adding generic review/meta layers.
new_candidate.falsifier: In matched executed-science tasks, if adding the certificate/failure-update gate while holding model/tools/budget fixed does not improve prospective validity, failed-hypothesis updating, or decision quality—or merely improves LLM-judge style scores—the candidate should be downgraded.

additional_primary_evidence.observation: AutoSOTA independently implements protocol-preserving red lines before and during optimization: paper-specific hard constraints are materialized before ideas, a mandatory audit rejects violating ideas before execution, Leap-path ideas are re-audited, and engineering repair is prohibited from changing evaluation semantics/dataset/methodological comparability.
additional_primary_evidence.scope_guard: This is implementation-convergence/architecture evidence. The paper does not provide a matched AgentSupervisor ablation, so it is not used as a causal effect estimate for the gate.

candidate_refinements.refinement: The W4394892346 panel again separates review prose from actual closure. Three severe critiques closed only when the final claims were materially downgraded or the challenged alternative was actually tested; three severe critiques remained open at termination, and none produced durable machine-actionable repair_pending state.
candidate_refinements.new_mechanistic_detail: A useful gate must distinguish (a) critique already absorbed by an appropriately narrow current claim, which should not create false repair work; (b) material claim downgrade that actually reconciles the load-bearing claim; and (c) caveat-only disclosure while a contradictory strong conclusion remains.
